layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one single town building for a strategy game's town screen, three-quarter view looking slightly down, thick dark outline, big simple shapes, whole and centred on the empty transparent background, filling most of the image; nothing is drawn under it.

Subject: each image a different one of these six storybook kingdom buildings: Squires' Hall (small timber-framed hall, a big round wooden shield over the door, a straw practice dummy); Archery Range (open wooden shed with round straw targets with red and white rings); Barracks (long stone barracks, red-brown tiled roof, a rack of spears); Friary (small stone friary with a bell gable and a little garden fence); Stables (timber stable with a hay-loft door and a gold horseshoe sign); Slayers' Lodge (stout stone lodge with a giant green dragon skull over the door). Materials: cream limestone #e6d8b4, white plaster with dark timbers, roofs tabard blue #2f6fd0 or red-brown #a8492f.
